# CDP (`cdp`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [L2 control protocols](../../protocols/l2-control.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`snap`](snap.md) | `pid` | 8192 (0x2000) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `2` |   | CDP protocol version (2). |
| `ttl` | `uint(8)` | `180` |   | Time this advertisement stays valid, in seconds. |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum over the header and everything after it | Internet checksum over the CDP header and TLVs (Auto). |
| `tlvs` | `tlv` — rest of the PDU |   |   | CDP TLVs (16-bit type, 16-bit length including the header). |

### `tlvs`

- Type 16 bits, length 16 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x0001) | `device_id` |   |   |
| 2 (0x0002) | `addresses` |   |   |
| 3 (0x0003) | `port_id` |   |   |
| 4 (0x0004) | `capabilities` |   |   |
| 5 (0x0005) | `software_version` |   |   |
| 6 (0x0006) | `platform` |   |   |
| 7 (0x0007) | `ip_prefix` |   |   |
| 10 (0x000a) | `native_vlan` |   |   |
| 11 (0x000b) | `duplex` |   |   |
